label: counts after reindex
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_note) AS notes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_link) AS links, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_dangling) AS dangling_targets, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_retrieval) AS retrievals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_session) AS sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_stage) AS stages

label: alpha inbound after reindex
sql: SELECT slug, inbound, outbound, pagerank FROM v_note WHERE slug IN ('alpha','lambda')

label: dangling after reindex
sql: SELECT target, citing_notes, cited_by FROM v_dangling ORDER BY target

label: pagerank nulls after reindex
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(pagerank IS NULL) AS null_pr, ROUND(SUM(pagerank),6) AS prsum FROM v_note

label: new edges present
sql: SELECT src,dst FROM v_link WHERE src='lambda' OR dst='lambda'
